acceptance.A1: Dependent z-seed then a-refine prepare roles use ordinary trusted Run submission, exact RunScope forks and accepted receipts. No Round/items exist during preparation; existing direct-input regression paths pass.
acceptance.A2: Lost committed intent, Run and receipt responses, process restart and stale claim delivery preserve submission/execution identity, durable Run counts, accepted receipts and single budget accounting. Accepted roles are not redispatched.
acceptance.A3: No-Round pause/resume preserves accepted inputs; deadline collects existing Runs without advancing dependencies; cancel/delete drain Runs and release holds. Exhausted missing-output attempts retain truthful exact partial evidence after Run deletion and produce no invented report/Round.
acceptance.A4: Attempts consume the existing submission window and budgets; retained outputs and failed-attempt diagnostics consume shared evidence bytes. Ordinary Scheduler and Control Plane regressions pass.
